create_ariadataprovider: create an AriaDataProvider instance from a VRS file path with optional MPS folder for sensor data
get_image_from_stream: get a raw image as a numpy array from a specific camera stream at a given timestamp
get_undistorted_image: get an undistorted pinhole image by applying calibration-based distortion correction to a fisheye camera frame
get_camera_calibration: get the camera extrinsics and intrinsics for a stream using either FISHEYE624 or LINEAR pinhole model
get_eye_gaze_in_camera: get the eye gaze vector projected into pixel coordinates on a given camera stream at a timestamp
